surfaced_pitfalls.disposition: owned by fixture-setup-hook-removal (removes the receipt path) and REQ-10 (no nested cargo build); watch for it in gate runs

traps: A shared-helper change (memory_executor) passed its worker's lib tests but broke integration targets on main (fast_issue graph_rule_validation_tests); main was red ~8 min and the merge was reverted (cf274f369). Workers changing a shared test helper must run every integration target that consumes it before handing back.
rules: Worktree source edits only; at most two active worktrees for this lead; >=60GB free before dispatch. CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. Builds: flock -o /tmp/jit-ci-turnstile.lock flock -o -s /tmp/jit-full-ci.lock <command>. Full validation and main merges use -x instead of -s. Do not pre-acquire cargo-ci.lock. Current main must be incorporated into the task branch and full workspace nextest plus workspace doctests pass before merge. No broad lock cleanup or fixture-timeout force exemption. Exact-path tracker commits. Fixed breakdown; scope changes escalate to coordinator 01a164c8-d7ba-7812-a630-db8dddcee05b.
